$comment: This app's half of the cross-repository contract, and it is data only.
The laws are not here. They are the failure messages of the gates in
`@nanisoft/prism-ui/gates`, which this app installs by pinning that package
exactly, so a change to a law lands once and reaches this app in one release
and cannot be declined here. What is here is the set of facts only this app
knows: which stylesheet is its own, how much of it counts as having read
something, where its export lands, what its pack map describes, and which
source roots carry no runtime token read.
The floors are deliberately low. This is the walking skeleton's app: one route,
no internal links yet, and a sheet the design system does almost all of. The
floors exist so a renamed directory empties a run and fails, rather than
reporting a repository that rendered nothing.
